12. type Result struct {
13. 	CompiledContent string

15. }

17. // SourceMapper can be used to find the origin of any line/column of the compiled content.
18. type SourceMapper func(genLine, genColumn int) (source, name string, line, column int, ok bool)
19. 
20. // Bundle returns either a Result or a list of Errors and an error.
21. func Bundle(inputFile string, define map[string]string) (Result, error) {
22. 	result := esbuild.Build(esbuild.BuildOptions{
23. 		EntryPoints:       []string{inputFile},
24. 		Bundle:            true,
25. 		Write:             false,
26. 		MinifyWhitespace:  false,
27. 		MinifyIdentifiers: false,
28. 		MinifySyntax:      false,
29. 		LogLevel:          esbuild.LogLevelInfo,
30. 		Platform:          esbuild.PlatformNode,
31. 		Define:            define,
32. 		Sourcemap:         esbuild.SourceMapExternal,
33. 		Outdir:            ".", // required for source maps
34. 	})
35. 
36. 	if len(result.Errors) > 0 {
37. 		// NOTE: esbuild prints the errors to the console by itself.
38. 		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("esbuild failed")
39. 	}
40. 
41. 	var bundle Result
42. 
43. 	// result.OutputFiles should have generated two files: the compiles source (.js) and the source map (.map)
44. 	// map to result.{CompiledContent,SourceMapper}
45. 	for _, file := range result.OutputFiles {
46. 		if strings.HasSuffix(file.Path, ".map") {
47. 			smap, err := sourcemap.Parse("", file.Contents)
